name: Ventilateur moteur 993 — archive du concept Carrera F0
description: Ce dossier conserve le concept exploratoire Carrera F0 : douze pales balayées, moyeu simplifié et anneau périphérique. Sa géométrie synthétique de 280 mm ne reproduit pas le rotor Porsche et son intégration au carter F0 échoue. Il ne constitue plus la base de la conception actuelle. La reprise du 28 septembre 2026 étudie séparément la 993 Turbo M64.60 : rotor 96410601522 à onze pales, cuvette ventilée, nervures et moyeu distinct, avec intégration visée du PMB / Classic Retrofit 240 A. Cette nouvelle reconstruction reste partielle et ses interfaces, débit, matière et tenue mécanique ne sont pas validés.

post_processing: orientation, supports and access between blades to be qualified
stress relief then T6 with quench and distortion monitored
mandatory HIP to be decided by the HCF/defect card, not by habit
machining of the hub, bore, faces and balance correction datums
controlled finishing of the blade roots with no notches and no trapped media
corrosion protection compatible with temperature and fretting
two-plane dynamic balancing in the final condition
supplier_requirements: traceable machine, parameters, orientation, supports, powder, recycling and batch
oriented coupons with tensile, HCF, fretting and hot corrosion tests
notched specimens and blade-root witnesses in the final surface condition
full CT, FPI and metallography with zoned defect criteria
metrology of hub, bore, runout, concentricity, blades, clearance and mass
proof of balance, overspeed, vibration, flow, blade loss/containment and endurance

titanium.galvanic_isolation: Qualify AlSi10Mg against shaft, hub, alternator, pulley, shims, fasteners and housing; address corrosion, fretting and differential expansion.

known_limits: Concept F0 archivé comme référence de conception. La reprise Turbo distincte est documentée dans twins/993-engine-cooling-fan-system-f0/REFERENCE_REBUILD.md ; ne pas transférer les résultats F0 au nouveau rotor.
The 300 x 300 x 150 mm is a commercial envelope, not an impeller drawing.
The 0.94/0.948 kg masses are commercial claims with no protocol and no weighing boundary.
The aluminum material has no grade, no process and no certificate; AlSi10Mg remains a candidate.
The 280 mm diameter, the 80/30 mm hub, the twelve blades and the ring are synthetic.
The previous F0 housing has a synthetic 252 mm throat: the computed radial clearance is -14 mm and the integration fails.
The 10,000/12,000 rpm cases, flow, pressure and temperatures are regressions with no 993 authority.
The centrifugal and modal screens pass, but the thermal screen fails; HCF, balance, flow and containment remain non-computable.
The STEP proves only a re-readable BREP; no manufacture, rotation, installation or start-up is authorized.
